goal: Crafting: find and use every recipe on the crafting screen (C); are tools worth making?

findings.title: Planks and Bricks (2 of 5 recipes) are locked behind Village era, which needs Day 3: unreachable in a normal short session
findings.detail: The crafting screen shows Planks x2 and Bricks x2 as 'Locked: The Workshop is unlocked in the Village era.' Tapping the Era box lists Village 0/1, Members 0/10, Stalls 0/2, Day 1/3. A day is 10 game minutes; at the observed 8-12 tps that is ~45 real minutes per day, so the two trade-good recipes cannot be tried in a 30-minute session. The goal of using every recipe could not be met. Expected: the lock is fine, but the day gate makes the Workshop recipes invisible in practice for a new player's first sitting.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 107; Start; Begin; pt key c (Planks/Bricks locked); close; pt click 110 58 (Era box)

findings.title: Cooked Meat advertises '45 energy (raw: 25)' but there is no way to eat on purpose
findings.detail: No Eat key on any of the 3 Controls pages and no Eat button in Inventory (I). Food seems to be eaten automatically: energy went 84 -> 99 after the first chop while apples went 2 -> 1, and 90.6 -> 99 around the chicken harvest; objective 2 'Eat something' completed on its own at tick 4550. Nothing on screen says food is auto-eaten or which food is eaten first, so the player cannot tell whether crafting Cooked Meat (1 meat + 1 wood) actually gains anything over raw meat.
findings.repro: craft Cooked Meat via C; open ? Controls pages 1-3 and Inventory (I); look for an eat action

findings.title: Crafting tools sets back objective 1 'Gather wood 10' because it counts held wood
findings.detail: Objective 1 read Wood 9/10 after 13 wood had been gathered (axe crafted in between). Crafting a pickaxe and cooked meat dropped it to 5/10, and a second pickaxe to 2/10. The game nudges you to craft (contextual 'Craft Pickaxe' button) while the first objective punishes doing so. Expected: count wood gathered, or warn before spending.
findings.repro: chop 1 tree (6 wood), mine 1 rock, craft Axe, chop a tree -> 9/10; craft Pickaxe -> 6/10

findings.title: Crafting screen says 'Ready: you can make 1' for both Axe and Pickaxe when only one can be afforded
findings.detail: With 6 wood and 5 stone, Axe (4w 2s) and Pickaxe (3w 3s) both show 'Ready: you can make 1'. Making one leaves too little wood for the other. The per-recipe count is correct alone but misleads when recipes share inputs.
findings.repro: gather 6 wood and 5 stone; press c

findings.title: Expanded Era box pushes the Inventory Info panel under the tip card
findings.detail: Tapping the Era box pushes the Objective panel down and the Inventory Info panel moves right to x~220, where the Tip card covers part of it.
findings.repro: with a Tip showing, pt click 110 58

findings.title: Game ran at 1-3 fps and 8-12 tps; screenshots and HUD lag a second or more behind state
findings.detail: Keys/clicks often landed late (one E press on a chicken registered only on the next attempt), and the HUD showed stale values (Wood 5/10 while the inventory had 2). With trees and rocks 60-280 m apart in the Moor, walking between them took 30-90 real seconds each.
findings.repro: pt status / pt state during normal play

verdict: The crafting screen is very clear: costs, effects, durability, exact shortfalls ('Need 2 more wood'), 'have 1 (19 uses left)', a contextual Craft button in the HUD, and status lines that credit the tool ('+3 from your axe'). Tools are clearly worth making: the Axe (+3 on a 4-6 base, +60% yield) and Pickaxe (+2 on 5, +40%) pay back after 2 uses and give ~60 wood / ~30 stone over their lifetime. But Cooked Meat has no player-facing eat action to show its value, and Planks/Bricks sit behind a Day-3 Village era nobody reaches in a first session.
